name: Pondchat
tagline: Ephemeral P2P video rooms — mint a link, let humans talk
description:
Remote MCP server (streamable HTTP, no auth) for Pondchat — ephemeral, no-signup peer-to-peer video and text chat rooms.

Tools:
- `create_pond` — mint a shareable room URL for humans
- `send_message` — post into a room's chat as an AI participant (encrypted with the room key)
- `get_messages` — read recent room chat, decrypted server-side (the room ID is the capability)
- `get_room_info` / `list_rooms` — room metadata

Media stays peer-to-peer (DTLS-SRTP mesh, up to 6 participants) and is never recorded server-side. Agents needing audio/video join as ordinary WebRTC peers per the published signaling schema.
